english_policy.waiver_notes: Leeds accepts English language qualifications equivalent to the test scores below. For applicants living in the USA, English can be met by Grade 12 English from the High School Diploma at 2.0 GPA (70%), AP English Language and Composition or English Literature and Composition grade 3 or above, SAT Evidence-Based Reading and Writing 650 with Maths 620 (SAT 1290, new scores) or ACT 26 in English, or an associate degree over two years with GPA 3.0; the Business School sets higher figures (ACT English 28, SAT EBRW 700, AP grade 3, Grade 12 English GPA 3.0). Applicants who studied in the USA for at least two years of an undergraduate degree taught in English need no further test.

english.notes: General undergraduate minimum, used by Computer Science and Mechanical Engineering: IELTS Academic or IELTS for UKVI (Academic), 6.0 overall with no less than 5.5 in each component. Economics (Leeds University Business School) requires 6.5 overall with no less than 6.0 in each component. Tests older than two years at course start are not accepted.

General undergraduate minimum, tests taken before 21 Jan 2026 (old 0-120 scale). Single test in a test centre; MyBest and Paper Edition not accepted. The Business School page gives no old-scale figure.

General undergraduate minimum, tests taken on or after 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale): 4 overall with no less than 4 in each component. Economics (Business School) requires 4.5 overall with no less than 4 in each component.

General undergraduate minimum: PTE Academic or PTE Academic UKVI, 60 overall with no less than 59 in each component; PTE Academic Online not accepted. Economics (Business School) requires 64 overall with no less than 60 in each component.

General undergraduate minimum: Cambridge English qualification (B1 Preliminary, B2 First, C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency depending on the course), 169 overall with no less than 162 in each component. Economics (Business School): B2 First or above, 176 overall with no less than 169 in any component.
